# Gradient noise per optimizer gradient

Each point uses 500 fresh batches of 80 episodes, grouped into ten jobs. Brackets retain the saved 90% delete-one-group jackknife intervals, with t(0.95,9) = 1.833113. Norms are in training-loss units, covariance traces in their squared units, and relative variance R is unitless. Variance and R intervals are the saved per-episode intervals divided by 80; no gradients or intervals were recomputed.

Resolution uses the signed interval for the squared mean (CSV), not the norm interval. The saved as-run norm intervals are direct norm jackknife intervals; the saved DPPO norm intervals transform the squared-mean endpoints. Both are retained, including the negative signed norm lower endpoint at update 126.

For unresolved means, the requested plug-in bound is R ≥ tr Cov(g) / (squared-mean upper endpoint). It treats variance at its point estimate and is separate from the joint ratio interval, which remains [0, ∞). Because cosine decreases with R, this gives an upper bound on (1+R)^(-1/2), not a resolved cosine estimate.

The without_PPO_and_GAE point at update 126 retains its fitted reward scale; its intervals condition on that scale. The saved collection uses full-batch normalization, previously checked against the training quarters. Cross-method reference lines compare different policies at equal update counts, not identical parameters.
